governing_cause: Quantum-L9/.github v3.36.0 (dcd9d00, ADR-033) admitted 8 class:domain profiles and declares all six consumer bindings canonically in semantics/domain_consumer_bindings.yaml, but Cursor-Governance's single producer driver (tools/authority/produce_projection_bundle.py) is keyed by projection profile, not by domain consumer binding; every committed bundle is pinned to the pre-domain authority revision dc96a8a; and compiler 0.10.0 does not implement runtime composition of a binding's domain set. No consumer can therefore materialize, verify, or activate its domain binding.
intervention: Extend the existing projection-publication path (one driver, committed bundle + bundle.lock.json, per-skill verifier, l9-projection-bundle-verify and trusted-replay workflows) with a binding-keyed mode that resolves a canonical l9.domain-consumer-binding by ref and materializes one per-domain bundle per required domain plus a binding lock; pilot on coding-agent@1; keep every consumer on its predecessor profile until its canonical unresolved coordinates, compiler binding composition, and post-merge trusted replay are closed. Consumers author no binding semantics locally; they pin the canonical binding and commit the generated bundle.
